assessment: The official National Information Center describes Sudan Spatial Portal as a national web map browser with OGC WMS/WFS services and links to geoportal.gov.sd. The Judiciary’s Aqari portal documents national land-registration services. The geoportal host timed out; no anonymous Kas parcel ID, geometry, schema, or CRS was obtained. This is unresolved access, not evidence of parcel absence.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official NIC page describes Sudan Spatial Portal as an interactive national spatial map browser and states that it provides OGC WMS and WFS services; it links to https://www.geoportal.gov.sd.

Official Judiciary Aqari page describes a national electronic service for registering and managing land and real-estate records, including search-certificate and subdivision procedures; no public parcel feature endpoint was exposed.
Official Judiciary land-registration administration page describes the General Registrar of Lands and registration procedures; it is national procedural context, not Kas-specific geometry evidence.
